'''Drev'starn''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]].

==Description==
[[File:Drevstarn_location.png|thumb|left|150px|Drev'starn's location on Bothawui]]
Drev'starn was located in a long, broad valley near the equator.<ref name="guide" /> It was Bothawui's largest city and had numerous parks, spacious malls and open plazas connected by wide, well-manicured streets.<ref name="sb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> Commercial and business districts surrounded the public areas, radiating towards the tall mountain cliffs. Here the numerous Bothan ministries regulated the day-to-day activities of the business community, interacting with the native economic concerns and the numerous megacorporations. 

So conducive to business were Bothan regulations that almost every important corporation in the sector maintained a satellite office here; some even transferred their corporate headquarters and established permanent residency.<ref name="sb" />
===Suburbs===
The city's residential suburbs surrounded the core of the city, and were located on the nearest band of foothills. Small plains beyond the "near foothills" provided some agriculture, although Drev'starn was dependent upon other nearby communities for food supplies. Simple family homes and intricately detailed [[clan]] homes dotted the forested hillsides, constructed to complement the natural surroundings - not to dominate them. 

There were also commercial districts; light industrial areas dotted the secondary band of foothills, which eventually led into the [[Kurual'grast Mountains]] surrounding the valley.<ref name="sb" />

It was also in the foothills that most intelligence networks maintained a safe house and operations center - the Empire maintained several communication and sensor posts thinly disguised as diplomatic residences, as well as the [[Rebel safehouse]].<ref name="sb" /><ref name="guide" />
==Transportation==
Repulsor-powered trams and transit tubes, as well as privately-owned speeders, provided abundant and cheap transportation for the residents, allowing for easy commutes to work and back.

==Locations==
The [[Drev'starn Spaceport]] and [[Exoticalia Pet Emporium]] were located in Drev'starn, as well as [[Merchant's Square]] and the [[Combined Clans Center Building]]. 

At the outskirts of the city the [[Imperial Consulate (Bothawui)|Imperial Consulate]] is located. Farther away, among the hills, the local [[Rebel safehouse]] was hidden.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>
